name: optional-null-stripped-on-insert
$comment: Optional-field normalization: an explicit JSON null for an optional(string) field is STRIPPED at insert (strip_unset_optionals) — the stored doc simply lacks the key, so a collect returns a doc with no `note` member at all. Full-equality comparison (after system-field normalize) is what makes the absence itself the assertion. Mirrors rust-client in_memory behavior and server txn.rs do_insert.
